about: Shared by desktop/src/shared/sync-protocol.test.ts and the Android SyncProtocolTest. senderKind pins the phone's classifier; conversationFrames pins how the PC parses a frame's sender. callFrames pin the call frames the phone builds and the PC parses; pcCallFrames pin the call actions the PC sends and the phone parses. transferFrames pin protocol 6's clipboard, share and file frames (from says which side may send each; that side must build exactly frame, and the other side must parse it into parsed); invalidTransferFrames must be rejected; fileNames pin how a receiver turns an offered name into the name it saves (before adding ' (1)' for a name already taken).
